personalInfo.name: Kaushal Patel
personalInfo.bio: I am a frontend developer with 3 years of experience creating modern, responsive, and performance-focused websites. I specialize in building fast-loading user interfaces using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, converting Figma designs into pixel-perfect websites, and significantly improving website performance and user experience for clients worldwide.

services.title: Next.js Development
services.description: I build fast, SEO-friendly modern websites that rank higher and load instantly using the power of Next.js 15+.

services.title: Figma to React
services.description: I convert complex UI designs into responsive, pixel-perfect websites with zero compromises on design integrity.

services.title: Website Optimization
services.description: I specialize in improving loading speeds, responsiveness, and Core Web Vitals to boost your conversion rates.

services.title: WordPress to Next.js
services.description: Modernize your outdated WordPress site with a high-performance Next.js frontend while keeping your content.

services.title: Landing Page Development
services.description: I create high-converting landing pages for startups that turn visitors into loyal customers through better UX.

process.title: Requirement Discussion
process.description: We dive deep into your business goals, target audience, and specific project requirements.

process.title: UI Planning
process.description: Reviewing Figma designs or creating high-fidelity wireframes to ensure design-to-code alignment.

process.title: Development
process.description: Writing clean, modular, and accessible code using React, Next.js, and modern styling tools.

process.title: Optimization
process.description: Rigorous testing for speed, SEO, and responsiveness across all devices and browsers.

process.title: Deployment
process.description: Launching your project on high-performance infrastructure like Vercel or Netlify.

projects.title: Zoey Kamran
projects.description: A vibrant and engaging portfolio for a young author, showcasing writing, milestones, and creative projects.
projects.problem: The client needed a platform that felt playful yet professional to house her growing body of work and achievements.
projects.solution: Implemented a Next.js frontend with Sanity CMS for easy content updates and Tailwind CSS for a colorful, responsive design.
projects.result: Successfully launched a modern digital presence that effectively showcases her book and creative milestones.

projects.title: Vision Deck
projects.description: A premium corporate website for a business agency specializing in hospitality and entertainment sectors.
projects.problem: The agency required a high-end digital identity that reflects their expertise in premium project management and hospitality.
projects.solution: Built a sleek, high-performance website with smooth scroll animations and an interactive service showcase.
projects.result: Established a strong professional digital presence that aligns with their premium brand positioning.

experience.description: Collaborated with startups and businesses to build high-performance, SEO-optimized web products. Specialized in converting Figma designs to pixel-perfect React code and optimizing Core Web Vitals for production applications.
Developed responsive user interfaces and modular component libraries. Focused on improving code quality and implementing smooth, meaningful animations using Framer Motion.
